# PPWR Compliance Screener

> Screens supplier packaging declarations for completeness and internal consistency against a
> versioned JSON ruleset. Not a conformity assessment.

## What it is

A supplier data collection tool for EU packaging conformity. A company sends each packaging supplier
a tokenised link; the supplier answers a material-adaptive questionnaire and uploads evidence; a
deterministic rule engine screens the submission and returns either a confirmation or a named list of
what is missing. Output is a per-item evidence bundle and a coverage report that can sit behind a
Declaration of Conformity.

## What it is not

Not a conformity assessment. Not legal advice. Not a substitute for a technical file, a notified body
or a competent authority. It screens documents for completeness and internal consistency; it does not
determine whether packaging conforms to Regulation (EU) 2025/40.

## Design

- n8n carries invites, tokens, reminders, escalation and state. PostgreSQL holds campaign state.
- A language model does exactly two bounded jobs: reading an uploaded document into structured
  fields, and writing the covering paragraph of a gap notice.
- No model produces a pass or a fail. Verdicts come from a rule engine over versioned JSON.
- Adding a check means editing one JSON file, not adding a node.
- Submissions are append-only; the same submission against the same ruleset version always produces
  the same findings.
